defects.name: PnL or fill calculated directly from trigger/stop price level
defects.root_cause: Assuming an order fills at the exact trigger price rather than the actual simulated bar fill / next-bar open.
defects.invariant: All order fills and PnL must be derived from actual execution bar prices or NT BacktestEngine reports, never trigger levels.

defects.name: Session classification reads bar open timestamp (.ts_event)
defects.root_cause: Reading ts_event allows decisions at interval start to know the bar outcome before it completes.
defects.invariant: Session attribution and indicator calculations must use completed bar timestamp (.ts_init).

defects.name: Resampling open-stamped 1s data with closed='right'
defects.root_cause: closed='right' includes the tick at timestamp T into the interval closing at T, looking 1 second into the future.
defects.invariant: For raw unshifted open-stamped Databento data, resample must use label='right', closed='left'.

defects.name: Multi-stream domain guard asymmetry (1s protected, 1m unprotected)
defects.root_cause: Filtering 1s data by authorized year/date while leaving coincident 1m data unfiltered.
defects.invariant: All coincident streams in a collector/study must apply identical authorized domain filtering.

defects.name: Mixed 1s/1m bar streams registered out of causal order
defects.root_cause: Adding coincident 1m bars before 1s bars causes 1m triggers to execute before 1s bars at that timestamp run.
defects.invariant: At coincident close timestamp T, 1s bars MUST process before parent 1m bar.

defects.name: Databento open-stamped bars loaded into NT without appropriate ts_init_delta
defects.root_cause: Missing delta causes NT event loop to process bars at open timestamp instead of bar close.
defects.invariant: Databento bars must add duration delta (1m: +60s, 3m: +180s, 5m: +300s) when creating NT catalog bars.

defects.name: Seal references audit conducted on older/different code hash
defects.root_cause: Promoting model or strategy using stale pass_NN.md from prior modified tree.
defects.invariant: Promoted seal must bind to audit_status whose audited_code_sha256 matches current code hash.

defects.name: Seal references validation report for different model hash
defects.root_cause: Promoting model artifact using validation metrics from a different model run.
defects.invariant: Promoted seal must bind to validation report whose validated_model_sha256 matches model_sha256.

defects.name: Promotion manifest missing mandatory terminal evidence hashes
defects.root_cause: Promoting without complete cryptographic chain (missing preflight, code, spec, model, or test hashes).
defects.invariant: All 9 mandatory terminal evidence fields must be present and verified in promotion manifest.

defects.name: Misclassifying 08:30:00 CT close as RTH or 15:15:00 CT close as ETH
defects.root_cause: Inclusive >= or strict < inequality error on close-timestamped session boundaries.
defects.invariant: 1m bar at 08:30:00 CT close is ETH; first RTH 1m bar is 08:31:00 CT close. Final RTH 1m bar is 15:15:00 CT close.

defects.name: Rolling window with center=True
defects.root_cause: Centered rolling window aggregates future observations symmetrically.
defects.invariant: All rolling calculations must be strictly backward-looking (center=False).

defects.name: Negative shift (.shift(-N)) in feature path
defects.root_cause: Pulling future prices backward into feature calculation columns.
defects.invariant: Negative shift is strictly forbidden in feature engineering; legal only in supervised target label construction with explicit pragma.

defects.name: Backward fill (.bfill() or method='bfill')
defects.root_cause: Propagating future valid values into past missing values.
defects.invariant: Missing values must use forward fill (.ffill()), interpolation on past values, or explicit drop, never backfill.

defects.name: pd.merge_asof without explicit direction='backward'
defects.root_cause: Default merge direction or forward/nearest directions align with future timestamps.
defects.invariant: All merge_asof operations must explicitly state direction='backward'.

defects.name: Random shuffling in cross-validation or train_test_split
defects.root_cause: Shuffling time-series samples leaks future regime and volatility data into training sets.
defects.invariant: All time-series model evaluations must use temporal splits (TimeSeriesSplit or shuffle=False).

defects.name: Self-referential seal or circular dependency in promotion DAG
defects.root_cause: Seal artifact claiming itself as evidence or cyclical promotion dependencies.
defects.invariant: Artifact DAG must be strictly acyclic: source/model -> validation -> audit -> seal -> promotion.

defects.name: Model feature count or ordering mismatch at inference runtime
defects.root_cause: Inference passing feature vectors in different column order than training matrix.
defects.invariant: Feature vectors must match model.feature_names_in_ exactly by name and sequence.
